sections.overview: This widespread South American pimelodid catfish occurs in several major river basins.
sections.identification: FishBase gives it the English common name duckbill catfish.
sections.habitat: It is a freshwater, bottom-dwelling fish recorded from the Amazon, Orinoco, Paraná and Parnaíba basins.
sections.diet: Adults feed mainly on fishes and crustaceans.
sections.behavior: Adults form schools and are mainly nocturnal.
sections.reproduction: The sources consulted provide no concise species-specific account of spawning or larval development.
sections.ecology: It co-occurs with S. elongatus; unlike S. cuspicaudus, it has rounded tail lobes, and S. trigonocephalus has a more triangular head.
sections.conservation: FishBase reports a global IUCN assessment of Least Concern from 2018.
